newsitem.title: JAPAN: Matsushita's profit to rise 36 pct in 96/97 - paper.
newsitem.headline: Matsushita's profit to rise 36 pct in 96/97 - paper.

text.p: Matsushita Electric Industrial Co Ltd is expected to post a parent current profit of 140 billion yen in the 1996/97 business year ending March, 10 billion yen more than previously predicted, a Japanese business daily reported on Thursday.
The figure represents a 36 percent rise from the previous business year, the Nihon Keizai Shimbun said.
Matsushita's parent sales are expected to reach 4.7 trillion yen in the current business year, about 100 billion yen more than the previous forecast, the paper said.

The strong earnings are mainly due to robust sales in its information and industrial machinery divisions, which include mobile communications equipment and personal computer peripherals, the paper said.
A Matsushita spokesman was not immediately available to comment on the report.
